title: Stable Spatial Strings · v0.9.5
changes: Rebuilt both String Lab and Five-Finger Chord Lab strings as single continuous triangle strips with shared joins, eliminating the overlapping quad seams seen in Quest.
Replaced separate coplanar green glow and bright core meshes with one shader-rendered luminous strand to avoid depth fighting.
Disabled depth writes only while rendering transparent strands; restored them immediately afterwards.
Added stable camera-facing miter joins with a bounded width, robust edge-on fallback and slight separation from hand-joint points.
Preserved the thumbstick shortcuts, five-note C–G scale, finger-dependent gradients, pitch response, individual snapping and falling fragments.
Added executable geometry and renderer regression checks; no API calls, database migrations or watcher changes.
